speaker: author (devotional voice)
question: Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.
premises: Praise at the door is the offering.
The cry 'jaya jaya maheśa' is both act and instrument.
Status (sanātha) turns into request (make possessed of a protector).
inference: Speech becomes bliss-giving; request to be made protected.
uncertainties: Whether śivadā means 'bliss-bestowing' or 'Śiva-giving' is unresolved.
